purpose: Causal offline topology replay of the qualified risk-calibrated GSE observation and fixed deployable baselines, selecting the pre-registered graph configuration without reading C10 or M-TARE worlds.

approval.scope: One immutable C09 V2 offline topology replay over 10 worlds, 2054 directed traversals and 24462 sequences; four methods each use the fixed 243-setting structural grid; zero model updates and zero C10/M-TARE reads.
approval.confirmation_reference: The user granted continuous execution for the fixed GSE-Graph paper program and instructed the agent to choose the best in-scope route without repeated approvals; the corrected perception PASS and exact topology workload were reported before this run.

raw_sources: Sealed PASS GSE deduplicated dataset V1 with exact ten C09 validation shards and sequence identities.
Sealed PASS GSE Teacher manifest V1 with validation traversal, event identity and association evidence.
Sealed PASS V1R three-seed GSE validation outputs.
Immutable original C09 perception FAIL used only for its sealed PASS event, exit, association and calibration components; its failed slope is never consumed.
Sealed PASS risk-calibrated perception V2 providing the complete gate and identity-aligned corrected slope for all three seeds.
excluded_sources: GT identity as a graph-builder input
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research use of project procedural worlds and derived LiDAR/Teacher/model evidence with complete provenance.

sampling.rule: Each validation parent is one independent unit. Its 24,462 anchors are consumed in deterministic directed-traversal Euler order; each model observation uses only its five-frame causal history. Parameter copies and three model seeds are repeated measurements, not new independent samples.

teacher.source: Sealed TNG event/node/edge identities define an evaluator-only corridor-compressed structural graph; sealed spline/mesh Teacher supplies the objective typed labels but never enters the graph builder.
teacher.valid_mask: Only observations already accepted by the sealed dataset Teacher masks are scored. Repeated predicted nodes, duplicate edges and unmapped edges remain in precision denominators.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Graph builders receive only current/past typed observations and current replay pose. Nodes are event-triggered or metric anchors; edges appear only after a recorded physical traversal. GT identity and future routes remain evaluator-only.

split.historical_pollution_audit: C09 is development validation and already exposed the V1 slope failure; V2 topology parameters may be selected on C09 but no strict-test claim is made. The old failed perception run contributes only explicitly qualified event/exit/association/calibration components, while slope is replaced by the C07-C08-selected V2 PASS output through a global-sequence-index bijection. C10 and M-TARE remain unread.

methods.gse: Risk-calibrated typed GSE observations with learned place/exit association and trace-verified edges.
methods.association_ablation: The same GSE event/geometry/uncertainty with descriptor association replaced by the fixed rule association.
methods.baselines: Exit-only M1D plus rule graph and deterministic five-frame geometry event plus rule graph; GT-TNG is diagnostic only.
methods.slope_interface: Only slope_deg is overlaid from the V2 PASS after exact global_sequence_index bijection; every other learned output stays from the sealed V1R model arrays.

metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.grid: Exactly 3^5=243 structural settings for every method/seed under the frozen ranges in docs/GSE_GRAPH_RESEARCH_PLAN_V1.md.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.selection: GSE association-safe first, then lexicographic node/edge fidelity and invariant error. Baselines use the same graph-fidelity ordering without hiding unsafe association.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.scientific_gate: GSE node F1 and edge F1 must each exceed the stronger corresponding deployable baseline by at least 0.05; association attempts must be nonzero with precision >=0.98 and false-loop rate <=0.01; absolute mean signed connected-component and cycle-rank errors must each be <=0.25.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU replay of 59,442,660 typed-observation updates across 24,300 world/config/seed replays; zero GPU inference, training or optimizer steps.

evidence.machine_metrics: Complete four-method parameter sweeps, one selected configuration each, per-world/seed nodes, edges, decision traces, association/invariant metrics, source verification before/after, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.
evidence.complete_visual_review: After PASS publish aggregate topology comparison and fixed S01/S06/S10 examples as PNG/PDF/SVG with CSV/JSON/provenance and hashes.
evidence.failure_policy: Any source/identity/slope-overlay drift, incomplete 243 grid, unsafe association, node/edge gain or invariant failure, C10/M-TARE read, update or resource overrun is FAIL and stops strict test/closed loop.
